item.title: Bridge collapse cuts off five Odisha GPs
item.description: Anandapur: A bridge over the Kukurua nullah on the Tartara–Kantipal main road in Keonjhar district’s Anandapur block collapsed Saturday morning, cutting off travel for residents of five panchayats who depend on the route. item.title: Elderly man killed by minor in dispute over pet mongoose
item.description: Kabisuryanagar: A 72-year-old man was killed by his minor neighbour with a sword at Patharapalli village under Kabisuryanagar police limits in Ganjam district Saturday. The deceased was identified as Krushnachandra Mohanty. According to reports, a neighbour’s domesticated mongoose entered Mohanty’s house Friday and ate chicken curry. item.title: Odisha okays 55 NEP textbooks
item.description: Bhubaneswar: In a first for the country, Odisha has translated and contextualised 55 new NCERT textbooks developed under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. item.title: Odisha: 19 held for illegal fishing
item.description: Rajanagar: Forest officials seized a trawler and arrested 19 persons for allegedly fishing illegally inside the Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary near Agarnasi, authorities said Saturday. item.title: Similipal shivers at 2°C
item.description: Baripada: A sharp fall in temperatures has intensified the cold wave across Mayurbhanj district, with Similipal recording a minimum of 2°C in the past 24 hours. item.title: ‘Dhurandhar’ leaked online! Ranveer Singh’s spy action thriller appears on torrent, piracy sites
item.description: Mumbai: Ranveer Singh–starrer Dhurandhar released December 5; however, within hours, the movie was leaked online. Illicit piracy platforms uploaded the film in multiple formats, ranging from low-quality 240p prints to full 1080p HD versions, making the title widely accessible through illegal channels. item.title: Security forces foil attack on Jaffar Express in Pakistan
item.description: Karachi: Security forces foiled an attempt to attack the frequently-targeted Jaffar Express passenger train in Pakistan’s Balochistan province, according to a media report Sunday.
